title: Northgate Purchases & Returns Desk Guidance: Return Eligibility, Return Windows and Return Authorizations
content:
This desk guidance states when merchandise bought through Northgate Purchases & Returns is accepted back and how a return without a club visit is authorised.

## Returnable merchandise and purchase status

Merchandise is returnable for a refund except the classes listed as non-returnable. A return refund is posted only on a purchase whose status is fulfilled or partially returned, or, as a cancellation refund, on a purchase whose status is cancelled. The basis is the status on the purchase's system record.

## The return window

A return is accepted only when it is requested no later than the effective return window, in calendar days after the fulfillment date of the purchase. Days are counted as calendar days, the fulfillment date being day 0, and a request on the last day of the window is in time. The effective return window is the channel-wide return window when that figure is not zero, and otherwise the window of the line's merchandise class; a class window of no limit never closes. The request date is the requested date of the return authorization, or the day the merchandise is handed in at a club counter. The basis is the purchase's recorded fulfillment date and the line's merchandise class on the system record.

A defect first reported after the window is directed to the channel's post-window route (the manufacturer's warranty or a Northgate Care protection plan), never refunded.

| Hypothetical line | Fulfillment date (day 0) | Effective window | Requested | Accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Television, in-club | 1 January | 90 days (class window) | 1 April (day 90) | yes |
| Television, in-club | 1 January | 90 days | 2 April (day 91) | no |
| Mattress, special order | 1 January | 30 days (channel-wide window) | 31 January (day 30) | yes |
| Mattress, special order | 1 January | 30 days | 1 February (day 31) | no |

## Where merchandise goes back

- Merchandise from a channel that accepts returns at any club can be handed in at any club membership counter, where the refund posts at the counter.
- Member services opens a return authorization only on a channel whose list of return methods is not empty, choosing freight pickup for the channel's freight pickup classes and the member's choice of the other listed methods otherwise.
- The authorization is recorded as submitted and takes effect when the member confirms it. The merchandise must reach the carrier within the channel's ship-by days, counted in calendar days from confirmation, or the authorization is withdrawn.
- A refund for merchandise that must come back is posted only after the return authorization for that sale line shows status received.

## Condition of electronics, and exchanges

Television, computer and tablet, cell phone and camera and drone returns must include every accessory where the channel requires accessories, or the returns center refuses them. Where the channel allows exchanges, an even exchange of the same item is made at a club counter without a refund.
